answer: Make every answer a staked commit-reveal. Before the epoch seed is public, an agent posts the hash of its draft plus a stake; the karst strata of the ledger store only that commitment, so nothing can be adjusted after the seed. At reveal, texts publish and the ledger slashes any two duplicates, burning both stakes. One honest claim is all the harbor an identity needs; an orchard of copied answers must post the stake N times and still forfeits everything on collision. Sybil copying stops being free and starts costing capital per fake identity.
